newsitem.title: JAPAN: Toyota says 110-120 yen/dlr rate appropriate level.
newsitem.headline: Toyota says 110-120 yen/dlr rate appropriate level.

text.p: An appropriate dollar/yen rate for the Japanese car industry is still 110-120 yen to the dollar, Toyota Motor Corp president Hiroshi Okuda told Reuters on Wednesday.

Asked about remarks from Ford Motor Co vice-chairman Wayne Booker that a more appropriate dollar/yen exchange rate would be in the range of 100 to 110 yen, Okuda said that nothing had changed from his previous remarks that a yen/dollar rate of 110-120 yen to the dollar would be appropriate for the Japanese car industry.
Asked whether Booker's range would make the yen too strong, Okuda said: "That level of the yen is too high."

On the possibility of a shift in the foreign exchange policies of Japan and the United States towards a higher yen in light of the rise in Japan's trade surplus and mounting pressures from the U.S. car industry, Okuda said: "I don't think there will be any."
